subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Do the OpenClaw tools and Codex supervision entrypoints intentionally share a diagnostic schema beyond error normalization and stderr routing, and if so, what exact fields or output divergence must a common helper enforce?
rationale: The issue proposes an architectural extraction but supplies no differing output examples or contract showing that the service-specific prefixes are duplicate policy rather than useful identity.

options.title: Request concrete divergence first
options.body: Ask for representative output from both entrypoints and define the shared invariant before approving a common formatter.

options.title: Keep service-local prefixes
options.body: Treat each fatal prefix as entrypoint identity and close the cleanup request if no broader shared schema is intended.

recommendation.title: Request concrete divergence first
recommendation.body: Ask for representative output from both entrypoints and define the shared invariant before approving a common formatter.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available reviewer connected to the merged MCP bridge history and its diagnostic surface.
